about.body: The AJ30 is Jaguar's 3.0-litre V6 petrol engine, produced from 1999 to 2012. It was derived from Ford's Duratec V6 family and used across two Jaguar model lines - the X-Type and the XF. The engine is generally well-regarded for its reliability, though certain components require attention as mileage accumulates.

byModel.body: Across the X-Type, the AJ30 powered the 3.0 V6 variant throughout the model's production run (2001-2009). The engine was the range-topping petrol option in the X-Type, providing the V6 performance that distinguished the range-topper from the four-cylinder variants. The XF continued with the AJ30 in its early years (2008-2012), using the same 3.0-litre V6 as the base petrol engine before the range transitioned to the newer AJ126 and Ingenium families.

compatibility.body: Because the AJ30 spans two different model lines with different chassis configurations, compatibility comes down to confirming your exact vehicle, which we do by registration. A V6 from an X-Type isn't a direct match for a V6 from an XF - ancillaries, mounting, and ECU calibration all differ. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm your exact vehicle.
